title: Dari sumur ke toren
visualLanguage: Simple pastel cutaway matching ImageGen reference, rebuilt as real Three.js volumes; original SVG motion study is not the final renderer.

sources.use: Style/structure reference inspected in browser at approximately 8, 20, 35, 45 and 56 seconds; no media downloaded or copied.
Centrifugal pump: liquid enters the impeller eye and moves toward its periphery.
Illustrative tank filling control: pump starts at a lower level and stops at an upper level. The demonstration uses a level controller, not a pressure-switch claim.

beats.caption:
Bagaimana air sumur
sampai ke atap?
beats.detail: Ikuti satu sistem, dari sumber hingga toren.
beats.purpose: Establish the question and spatial relationship
beats.action: Reveal source, pump and tank in order

beats.caption:
Perjalanan dimulai
di sumber air.
beats.detail: Ujung pipa terendam. Jalurnya terisi air.
beats.action: Follow water entering the submerged intake

beats.caption:
Motor memutar
impeller.
beats.detail: Putaran ini memberi energi pada air.
beats.action: Open pump cover; reveal rotor and radial flow

beats.caption:
Masuk dari tengah.
Keluar menuju tepi.
beats.purpose: Explain the flow through a centrifugal pump
beats.action: Trace the eye-to-periphery flow and discharge

beats.caption:
Tekanan mendorong air
melewati pipa tegak.
beats.detail: Ketinggian dan hambatan pipa perlu diatasi.
beats.purpose: Connect pump energy to vertical transport
beats.action: Travel upward with the visible water stream

beats.caption:
Di toren,
air mulai terkumpul.
beats.detail: Cadangan air kini berada di atas.
beats.purpose: Reveal storage as the result of pumping
beats.action: Show inlet stream and rising water level

beats.caption:
Batas atas mengakhiri
pengisian.
beats.detail: Kontrol level mematikan pompa saat toren penuh.
beats.action: Lift the float, show controller signal, stop the impeller

beats.caption:
Pompa beristirahat.
Air tetap bisa dipakai.
beats.detail: Dari toren, air turun oleh gravitasi.
beats.action: Follow a separate outlet pipe down to the tap

beats.caption:
Air dipakai.
Level toren turun.
beats.purpose: Explain why the system needs to restart
beats.action: Drain tank visibly while the tap runs

beats.caption:
Batas bawah tercapai.
Pompa menyala lagi.
beats.action: Send ON signal, accelerate rotor and restart the rising stream

beats.caption:
Putaran. Tekanan.
Aliran yang teratur.
beats.purpose: Resolve the original question as a complete system
beats.action: Return to the full diagram with a running refill cycle
